subject: Post-demo: Tradecraft model-fit recap & pilot next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Khan <samira@tradecraft.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: 2025-08-03T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: Tradecraft model-fit recap & pilot next steps

Hi Samira — thanks again for the demo session today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we stay aligned.

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary workload: multi-turn policy/knowledge assistant with mixed short/long context (avg prompt ~1.5k tokens, occasional 6–8k).
- SLA targets: p95 latency target ~250–400ms depending on model family; throughput target ~40–60 TPS for pilot bursts.
- Quality risk areas: instruction-following for long contexts and hallucination on proprietary docs.

Redwood initial model recommendations (verified candidates)
- rw/llama-65b-q4hf: best quality for long-context tasks; expect higher memory but strong instruction fidelity.
- mosaic/mpt-30b-instruct-q8: good tradeoff for throughput when latency is primary constraint.
- rw/opt-13b-8k-q4: cost friendly baseline for comparison.

What I ran after the call (attached + links)
- Redwood-verified performance profiles for the three candidates (p50/p95 latencies, sustained TPS, GPU config) attached as redwood_perf_profiles_tradecraft_v1.pdf and viewable here: https://console.redwood.ai/benchmarks/TRD-4381
- Prompt-set snapshot and initial eval harness attached (tradecraft_promptset_v1.json).

Proposed 2‑week pilot (minimal scope)
- Models: run parallel A/B across rw/llama-65b-q4hf and rw/opt-13b-8k-q4 for production-like traffic.
- Throughput: configure to sustain 50 TPS burst, 20 TPS sustained.
- Metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens per second (TPS) under sustained load, quality pass-rate against your rubric ( >= 90% target), hallucination incidents.
- Rollout: canary 10% -> 50% over 48 hours, automatic fallback to opt-13b on latency regressions.

Ask from you
1) Confirm pilot scope and legal contact for the SOW (I can route a pilot SOW).
2) Any additional prompt variants or edge-case documents you want in the eval set?
3) Do you have retention/KMS constraints we should include?

Next steps
- If OK, I’ll push a pilot SOW (DocuSign) and schedule a 30-min technical kickoff with your infra team.

Thanks — I’ll loop Marissa and Ben for the bench artifacts.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Tradecraft model-fit recap & pilot next steps

Karthik — really helpful, thanks. A couple quick clarifying items before we sign off on pilot SOW: 

- Retention: our default policy is 30 days for logs, any inference artifacts with customer data must be purged after 14 days unless HIPAA-protected. Can you confirm retention controls (and KMS/HSM options)?
- Safety: curious about Redwood’s built-in filters for PII redaction and the regression alerts you mentioned during the demo. How are those surfaced?
- Latency expectations: can you share an example p95 vs TPS table for rw/llama-65b-q4hf? That will help set expectations for our SREs.

Also looping in procurement for the SOW cadence. We tentative OK the pilot scope but want the retention/KMS answer before final sign.

—Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Product
Tradecraft.ai

Date: 2025-08-03T18:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Tradecraft model-fit recap & pilot next steps — evaluation artifacts

Adding a few technical artifacts and suggested configs for the pilot so we can move fast after Karthik confirms retention items. I uploaded the raw bench logs and an eval harness snapshot to the Drive link Karthik included. Quick notes: 

- Attachment: tradecraft_promptset_v1.json (includes 120 prompt pairs: short-turn, long-context, multi-step reasoning).
- Perf expectations (rough numbers from internal rails on A100-like instance):
  * rw/llama-65b-q4hf @ 1 instance (8xA100 equiv): p50 ~110ms, p95 ~360ms at sustained 45 TPS with optimized batching (prefix cache on).
  * rw/opt-13b-8k-q4 @ 2 instances: p50 ~80ms, p95 ~220ms at sustained 50 TPS (lower quality but faster).
  * mosaic/mpt-30b-instruct (quantized): p50 ~95ms, p95 ~280ms at 40 TPS.

- Quality regression note: instruction following regresses primarily on snippets where relevant context is split across >2 passages. Recommend adding a regression test that includes 20 long-context cases from your docs set. We’ll wire alerting to your Slack channel if pass rate drops >5% vs baseline.

- Recommended rollout: start rw/opt-13b as baseline (60% traffic), canary rw/llama-65b at 10%, evaluate quality for 48h and then expand to 30% if stable.

I’ve attached a small CSV with the pilot metric snapshot (pilot-metrics-snapshot.csv) and the perf profile PDF that Karthik referenced. Happy to hop on a short call with your infra/security folks for KMS/retention details.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Samira — thanks, good questions. Short answers here and I’ll have our security lead share a formal retention/KMS note by EOD tomorrow.

- Retention & KMS: We support configurable retention policies per-customer (14/30/90 days) and customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integrations. We’ll include the option to enable no-logs mode for piloted endpoints in the SOW.
- Safety & regression alerts: Redwood Optimize runs continuous quality checks against provided prompt sets. Regression alerts are pushed to Slack/email; we can also create a ticket in your Jira.
- Example p95 vs TPS: see the attached perf PDF and the quick table below (from the attached profiles):

  Model: rw/llama-65b-q4hf | Instance profile: 8xA100 equiv | Sustained TPS: 45 | p50: 110ms | p95: 360ms
  Model: rw/opt-13b-8k-q4  | Instance profile: 2xA100 equiv | Sustained TPS: 50 | p50: 80ms  | p95: 220ms

Action items
1) I’ll send the pilot SOW DocuSign link: https://docuSign.com/sow/TRD-4381-pilot (attached pilot-sow-tradecraft.docx for review).
2) Marissa — can you provision the canary config and sample alert job for Tradecraft?
3) Ben — I’ll need pricing approval for a pilot credit (we discussed a small usage credit to start).

Proposed next call: Tue Aug 5, 09:00 PT — 30 min tech kickoff. If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and the HubSpot link for the deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/TRADECRAFT/TRD-4381

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

—Karthik
